Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1075152. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary filtering by target ChEMBL ID. Join to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain molecule identifiers and canonical SMILES. Filter for standard type IC50, exact standard relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit output to the first 1000 rows.
